system: You are a document reader processing a LARGE batch under tight output limits to save tokens/cost. Summarise the whole batch in AT MOST 90 words: at most one very short bullet per noteworthy document (<=8 words each); omit routine/boilerplate documents entirely; end with a one-line overall takeaway. exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- C01 (Production index) ---
Cirrus Components document production, tranche 3, cover index. 15 documents, Bates CIR-004100 to CIR-004380. Produced subject to confidentiality order.

--- C02 (Invoices) ---
Accounts-receivable invoice batch, Q1. Routine billing to several customers including Meridian. Amounts and dates only.

--- C03 (QA log) ---
Quality log entry, 14 March: 'Batch 7 sensor yield anomaly flagged at incoming test; dispositioned use-as-is, monitor field returns.'

--- C04 (HR) ---
Staff roster and shift schedule for the quarter. Routine.

--- C05 (Internal email) ---
Email from engineering lead to QA manager, 5 April: 'I'm not certain, but the field dropouts we're hearing about might be the Batch 7 units - we should run the tests before we say anything externally.'

--- C06 (Logistics) ---
Shipping manifest: Batch 7 units despatched to Meridian on 22 March, with carrier and tracking references.

--- C07 (Purchasing) ---
Purchasing note, February: 'Resin lot substituted to a lower-cost alternative for Batch 7; vendor certificate of analysis states variance within tolerance.'

--- C08 (Marketing) ---
Product launch marketing deck. Messaging and positioning slides. Routine.

--- C09 (Support tickets) ---
Customer support export: three Meridian units logged with intermittent sensor dropout, tickets opened 2-9 April.

--- C10 (Ops minutes) ---
Operations meeting minutes, 18 March: 'Decision to proceed with Q1 shipments to meet quarter targets; outstanding QA monitor items noted as non-blocking.'

--- C11 (Expenses) ---
Expense reimbursement report for the sales team. Routine.

--- C12 (Facilities) ---
Facilities memo on car-park allocation and building access. Routine.

--- C13 (Supplier CoA) ---
Resin supplier certificate of analysis for the substituted lot: records a measured parameter near the edge of the stated tolerance band.

--- C14 (Customer email) ---
Unrelated routine customer email about a reorder of a different product line.

--- C15 (IT policy) ---
IT acceptable-use policy, standard terms. Routine.

Write your per-document notes.

- C03: Batch 7 yield anomaly accepted; field returns monitored.
- C05: Engineering suspects Batch 7 field dropouts; testing advised.
- C06: Batch 7 shipped to Meridian, 22 March.
- C07: Lower-cost resin substituted; vendor claimed tolerance compliance.
- C09: Three Meridian sensor-dropout tickets opened in April.
- C10: Q1 shipments proceeded despite outstanding QA monitors.
- C13: Resin parameter measured near tolerance limit.

Overall takeaway: Possible link between Batch 7 QA concerns and Meridian dropouts; evidence remains inconclusive.
